class.name: SteamWorkshopLegalAgreementStatus
class.brief_description: The signed-in user's Workshop legal agreement status for the exact AppID.
class.description: Use [member needs_action] to determine whether Steam needs the user to accept the latest version. The user may have accepted an older version. Open the agreement explicitly with [method SteamWorkshop.show_legal_agreement].

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the AppID Steam confirmed for this status.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns the version of the signed agreement when applicable.

method.name: get_accepted_at_unix
method.description: Returns the signed agreement's Unix timestamp when available.

method.name: is_accepted
method.description: Reports whether Steam says the user accepted the reported version.

method.name: get_needs_action
method.description: Reports whether the user needs to accept the latest agreement.

members.member: Exact active AppID reported by Steam.
Agreement version reported by Steam, or zero when unavailable.
Time Steam recorded the agreement action, or zero when unavailable.
Whether the reported agreement version was accepted.
Whether Steam requires user action for the latest agreement.
